# Mango Office SIP Documentation
> Documentation and support resources for configuring SIP telephony, virtual PBX integrations, and related Mango Office services.

Mango Office provides business telephony, SIP connectivity, virtual PBX features, and integration guidance for developers, administrators, and partners. This index highlights the most useful documentation and support areas for LLM-oriented discovery.

## Main Documentation
- [Mango Office SIP Portal](https://mangosip.ru/): Main entry point for Mango Office SIP-related documentation and service information.
- [Knowledge Base](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/): Central support area with setup instructions, troubleshooting, and product documentation.
- [Help Center](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/help/): General help materials for telephony services, account settings, and feature usage.
- [Virtual PBX](https://www.mango-office.ru/products/virtualnaya-ats/): Product overview and feature information for Mango Office virtual PBX.
- [SIP Trunk](https://www.mango-office.ru/products/sip-trunk/): Information about SIP trunking capabilities and business telephony connectivity.

## SIP Setup and Configuration
- [SIP Phone Setup](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/help/sip-telefony/): Configuration help for supported SIP phones and endpoint registration.
- [Softphone Setup](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/help/softfony/): Instructions for configuring software-based SIP clients and telephony applications.
- [SIP Account Settings](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/help/nastroyka-oborudovaniya/): Guidance for account credentials, server parameters, and device configuration.
- [Equipment Configuration](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/help/oborudovanie/): Documentation for connecting and configuring telephony hardware with Mango Office.
- [Telephony Connection Parameters](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/help/parametry-podklyucheniya/): Reference information for SIP connection settings and service parameters.

## Virtual PBX Administration
- [PBX Setup Help](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/help/virtualnaya-ats/): Administrative guidance for configuring virtual PBX features and call routing.
- [Call Routing](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/help/marshrutizaciya-vyzovov/): Instructions for routing incoming calls, queues, and distribution logic.
- [Extensions and Employees](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/help/sotrudniki-i-dobavochnye/): Managing users, extensions, and internal telephony assignments.
- [Voice Menu and IVR](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/help/golosovoe-menyu/): Setup guidance for IVR menus, greetings, and caller navigation.
- [Call Recording](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/help/zapis-razgovorov/): Documentation for enabling, accessing, and managing call recordings.

## Integrations and API
- [Integrations](https://www.mango-office.ru/products/integrations/): Overview of CRM and business system integrations supported by Mango Office.
- [API Documentation](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/help/api/): Reference materials for working with Mango Office APIs and automation features.
- [CRM Integration Help](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/help/integracii-s-crm/): Setup instructions for connecting telephony with CRM platforms.
- [Webhooks and Events](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/help/webhooks/): Information about event delivery, callbacks, and integration triggers.
- [Developer Resources](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/help/razrabotchikam/): Technical materials for developers integrating Mango Office services.

## Numbers and Telephony Services
- [Phone Numbers](https://www.mango-office.ru/products/nomera/): Information about available business numbers and telephony number services.
- [City Numbers](https://www.mango-office.ru/products/gorodskie-nomera/): Details on obtaining and using geographic business phone numbers.
- [8-800 Numbers](https://www.mango-office.ru/products/nomer-8800/): Product information for toll-free 8-800 business numbers.
- [Mobile Numbers](https://www.mango-office.ru/products/mobilnye-nomera/): Information on mobile telephony number options for business use.
- [Number Connection Help](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/help/podklyuchenie-nomerov/): Guidance for connecting and managing phone numbers in the platform.

## Analytics and Call Management
- [Call Analytics](https://www.mango-office.ru/products/analitika-zvonkov/): Overview of analytics tools for monitoring calls and telephony performance.
- [Reports](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/help/otchety/): Help materials for generating and interpreting telephony reports.
- [Call History](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/help/istoriya-zvonkov/): Documentation for viewing call logs, statuses, and communication history.
- [Monitoring and Control](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/help/monitoring/): Guidance for supervising telephony operations and agent activity.
- [Statistics](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/help/statistika/): Reference for service metrics, usage data, and reporting features.

## Troubleshooting and Support
- [Support Home](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/): Main support portal for troubleshooting and service assistance.
- [FAQ](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/help/faq/): Frequently asked questions about telephony setup, billing, and service behavior.
- [Diagnostics](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/help/diagnostika/): Troubleshooting steps for identifying and resolving telephony issues.
- [Common Errors](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/help/oshibki/): Reference for common configuration and connection problems.
- [Contact Support](https://www.mango-office.ru/support/contacts/): Support contact information for obtaining technical assistance.

## Guides and Product Resources
- [Blog](https://www.mango-office.ru/blog/): Articles about business telephony, contact centers, and communication best practices.
- [Case Studies](https://www.mango-office.ru/cases/): Customer stories showing practical uses of Mango Office telephony solutions.
- [Products](https://www.mango-office.ru/products/): Catalog of Mango Office telephony, analytics, and communication products.
- [Contact Center](https://www.mango-office.ru/products/contact-center/): Information about contact center capabilities and customer communication tools.
- [Business Telephony](https://www.mango-office.ru/products/telefoniya-dlya-biznesa/): Overview of telephony solutions designed for business communications.
